summary: Batch #21 verification (login rate limit + media_token + Notifications screen + image regression) — ALL PASS. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_batch21_rate_limit_media_token.py. (a) Login rate limit: 5 wrong-password attempts with a throwaway email TEST_ratelimit_probe_<uuid>@x.com return 401 each; 6th returns 429 with Retry-After header (measured 599s, ~10min lock). Correct board@fam.com/secret123 login returns 200 and is unaffected. Success-clears-counter test verified: after 2x wrong + 1x correct login, 4 subsequent wrong attempts still return 401 (never hit 429). (b) media_token: GET /api/auth/me returns a 'media_token' string field. Using media_token as Bearer on /api/home returns 401 ('media' scope rejected by get_current_user). Uploaded a tiny probe.jpg via POST /api/upload, then GET /api/files/{path}?token=<media_token> returned 200 with the file bytes; GET /api/files/{path} with full user token in Authorization header returned 200; GET /api/files/{path} with NO token returned 401. (c) Regression: /api/auth/me + 6 core authed GETs (/home, /families/members, /events, /notices, /vault/items, /emergency/medical) all 200 with a normal full Bearer token. Frontend (Expo web @ 375x812, board@fam.com/secret123, dismissed 'Tap to relive' overlay): Home 10/0 broken, Family 16/0 broken, member Profile 18/0 broken — the media-token wiring did not break image loading. Notifications screen (/settings/notifications) opens from More → Notifications (testID more-notifications), renders the 'Notifications' heading, the 'Push notifications / Available in the mobile app' status card (web is unsupported — expected), and the YOU'LL BE NOTIFIED ABOUT list with all 5 items (On This Day memories, family chat, RSVP, noticeboard, SOS). No red screen, no unrelated console errors, no failed /api/* requests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:204-207 make_media_token embeds scope='media' + family_id + 7-day exp — correctly signed with same JWT_SECRET so /api/files can decode without an extra secret. Read-only guard at server.py:237-238 rejects media-scoped tokens on any get_current_user-protected route (verified via /api/home 401).

server.py:257-308 login throttle is MongoDB-backed with per-email + per-IP counters, 10-min account lock and 5-min IP lock, aggregation pipeline resets counter when window elapses. _clear_failures on success wipes both keys — success-clears-counter regression verified end-to-end.
server.py:255 DUMMY_BCRYPT_HASH runs pwd_context.verify even when the user doesn't exist so timing doesn't leak account existence — good hardening, complements the rate limit.

server.py:4257-4290 /api/files decodes token from either Authorization header or ?token= query; media-scoped tokens carry family_id inside the JWT so no user lookup is needed for family-scope check on the media path (fast + auth-DB-independent). Full user tokens still do a users.find_one — correct.

frontend/src/lib/api.ts:16-20,62-87 media token stored in module var, set from /auth/me on every mount; mediaImageSource uses ?token=<mediaToken || authToken> on web and Authorization header on native. Web fallback to authToken is only for the transitional window before the first /auth/me refresh — acceptable, but consider gating on Platform.OS === 'web' && !mediaToken to explicitly avoid leaking the login token in query strings; today it still would if a media call happens before /auth/me lands. Not a regression, low priority.

app/settings/notifications.tsx renders correctly on web with the 'Available in the mobile app' copy; status card uses '#8AB07D' green when 'granted' — good contrast. All alert rows use Ionicons with 22*22 background circles — touch target size is fine because rows are non-interactive on this screen.
